synopsis: Volume 1 (2022-11-30) Cover Illustration: Tsubasa Takamatsu 1. Hakanage na Reijou wa Yarinaoshitai (儚げな令嬢はやり直したい) [Kei Mayuzumi x Aoi Sakimori] 2. Gyakkou Reijou wa Moto Fiancé no Sugao wo shiru (逆行令嬢は元婚約者の素顔を知る) [Miko Yumoto x Akina Nakamuro] 3. Makimodori Joou Heika wa Saishou no Tenohira de Odoranai (巻き戻り女王陛下は宰相の手の平で踊らない) [Koma Toyama x Ecchan} 4. Konyaku Haki sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa Danzai Ibento wo Yarinaosu (婚約破棄された悪役令嬢は断罪イベントをやり直す) [Cosaji x Saaya Mizuno] Volume 2 (2023-4-28) Cover Illustration: Tsubasa Takamatsu 1. Yowamushi Reijou to Kaeru no Tebiki (弱虫令嬢とカエルの手引き) [Kuina Kurosuke] 2. Maki Modotta Hoshi Bara no Otome wa Akumu wo Harau (巻き戻った星薔薇の乙女は悪夢を祓う) [Chikage Nakakura] 3. Nanadome no Jinsei de, Watashi ga Negatta Koto wa (七度目の人生で、私が願ったことは) [Shun Mugisaki x Momozo Kira] 4. Shi ni Modori Reijou Violetta Martin ga Aisareru no wo Akiramete Suki ni Ikita Sono Tenmatsu. (死に戻り令嬢ヴィオレッタ・マルタンが愛されるのを諦めて好きに生きたその顛末。) [Aruhi Hamonaga x Yamori Michikusa] Volume 3 (2023-11-30) Cover Illustration: Tsubasa Takamatsu 1. Tatoe Sono mi ga Namekuji ni Naroutomo (たとえその身が蛞蝓になろうとも) [Hoshina x Yuu Kizaki] 2. Kako ni Modottanode Ane wo Yandere kara Mamottara, Kawarini Imouto no Watashi ga Kankin
